CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.

   D. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

6. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.

7. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Handball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Handball.

8. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.

10. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
